meta.name: linkedin-humanizer
meta.description: Remove AI tells from LinkedIn posts/comments: 2026 vocabulary density, reveal bridges, staccato fragments, stacked triads, performed sincerity. Tiered rewriter plus `--mode audit` LinkedIn post auditor and `--mode profile` voice builder. Not for drafting from scratch (use linkedin-post-writer) or beating AI detectors. Keywords: humanize, de-AI, post audit, post auditor, audit before posting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把读起来像 AI 写的 LinkedIn 帖子和评论改回自然口语
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果帖子被人说像 AI 写的却不知道从哪改起
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite LinkedIn posts and comments that read like AI back into natural human voice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if people say your posts sound AI-written and you don't know what to fix

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会改写你给的 LinkedIn 帖子、评论或私信,删掉 AI 痕迹,产出改写稿、改动对比、逐句困惑度估计和 human / mixed / AI-likely 置信度;也能只审不改。
howto.when: 当你提到 “humanize”、“de-AI”、“audit before posting” 等关键词,或要求对写完的草稿做发布前审查时,它会接管。

say.text: 把这段 LinkedIn 帖子人性化一下,去掉 AI 味
say.note: 输出改写稿、改动对比和置信度

say.text: 投稿前帮我审一下这篇稿子
say.note: 只做通过/不通过检查,不改写

say.text: 用 aesthetic 模式改写这段文字
say.note: 额外套用破折号、三段式等风格规则

howto.what_en: Claude rewrites LinkedIn posts, comments, or DMs you give it to remove AI tells, returning the rewritten text, a diff, per-sentence perplexity, and a human/mixed/AI-likely confidence. Audit mode reviews without rewriting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "humanize", "de-AI", "audit before posting", or ask for a pre-publish review of a finished draft.

say_en.text: Humanize this LinkedIn post and strip the AI tells.
say_en.note: Returns rewritten text, diff, and confidence.

say_en.text: Audit this draft before I post it.

say_en.note: Adds style rules like em dashes and triads.
